description: WSPR reference signal — one 120 s slot of complex baseband I/Q at 375 Hz, interleaved little-endian f32 (I, Q, …). wsprsim-synthesized at 0 dB SNR; decodes to the canonical message "K1JT FN20 20". Used by blocks/tests/wspr_e2e.rs to validate the vendored wsprd decode core + FFTW→kiss_fft swap.
layout: interleaved I,Q (Q uses the wsprsim sign convention — negate on read)
